newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Corn: Net sales of 671,000 MT were off 28 percent from the previous week, but equaled the 4-week average.

Japan (493,400 MT) was the major purchaser, followed by South Korea (97,100 MT), Taiwan (58,700 MT), Algeria (35,300 MT), and Mexico (34,300 MT). Decreases of 136,800 MT were reported for unknown destinations. Exports of 852,200 MT were 17 percent lower than the prior week and 13 percent less than the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (356,000 MT), Taiwan (153,700 MT), and South Korea (149,600 MT).
Net sales of 929,500 MT were two and nine-tenths times the previous week and one-third above the 4-week average.
